caption: TABLE 4 Nutritional Screening: Risk Factors as Determined by Life Stage, Medical/Dietary History, or Physical Exam
rows: Life stage with specific nutritional requirements (e.g., growth, gestation, lactation, senior, geriatric)
Altered gastrointestinal function (e.g., vomiting, diarrhea, reduced fecal quality, nausea, flatulence, constipation)
Currently receiving medications and/or dietary supplements
Calories from noncomplete and balanced foods > 10% of total caloric intake (e.g., commercial treats, table foods, chew bones, foods for medication administration)
Unconventional diet (e.g., raw meat based, home prepared, vegetarian, vegan)
Muscle condition score with mild, moderate, or severe muscle wasting
note: 本图右侧另含 TABLE 5「Examples of Clinical Diagnostics for an Extended Nutritional Assessment」（单列表格，无表头），条目：Complete blood count; Serum biochemistry; Urinalysis; Thyroid screen; Fecal flotation and antigen testing (e.g., Giardia); Urine protein:creatinine ratio*; Vitamin B12 (cobalamin)*; Folate*; PLI, species specific*; TLI, species specific*; 25-hydroxyvitamin D*; Whole blood or plasma taurine*; Plasma amino acids*; Abdominal and/or thoracic imaging*
